content:
Hello! I am working on mathlib's TODO for formalizing transfer for Hyperreal
using Łoś's theorem.

I have a prototype that compiles against current mathlib. It contains:

  1. Łoś specialized to constant ultrapowers.
  2. An equivalence between constant Filter.Germ and Filter.Product.
  3. Generic formula and sentence transfer for germs.
  4. Ring-language compatibility and Hyperreal transfer.

I plan to submit this as several small PRs. I would like to begin with only
the two constant-ultrapower lemmas in ModelTheory/Ultraproducts.lean.

The implementation was developed with the assistance of
HyperrealTransfer.lean
README.md
GPT 5.5xh (Codex).
I have compiled the resulting Lean file locally.

Does this division and starting point look appropriate?

It now supports:

  • Ring operations and equality.
  • Native ≤ and derived <.
  • Logical connectives.
  • Arbitrary first-order quantifiers.
  • Formulas with standard real parameters.
  • Sentence transfer.
  • Elementary equivalence of ℝ and ℝ*.
